definition.name: Cinematic Combat Lite

style_injections.content: If [OPPONENT STATUS] becomes 'Defeated': Contextualize the finish based on the player's last intent. If they were Aggressive/Lethal -> describe a fatal blow. If they were Trickery/Subtle -> describe a knockout or incapacitation. If Honorable -> describe a surrender.

definition.description_short: A narrative combat system using abstract States (Healthy -> Defeated) and Skill Checks rather than HP and Damage math

body.description_short: A narrative combat system using abstract States (Healthy -> Defeated) and Skill Checks rather than HP and Damage math

definition.name: D100 5 Pillars

logic.description: Look for the specific skill. If null, automatically find the parent 'root_' tag in the schema and use that value.
Add the difficulty modifier to the resolved skill value.
Roll the D100 using the physics engine.
Send the structured result to MAS 2.

style_injections.content: Narrate the outcome based on the Stat Source. If the source was FORCE, describe physical impact/strain. If FINESSE, describe speed/grace. If INSIGHT, describe sudden realization. Reflect the Degree of Success (Margin) in the intensity.

instructions.logic: Analyze the user's verb. If it matches a known Expansion Skill (e.g. 'Hide'), request that ID. If not, map to the nearest of the 5 Roots. DEFAULT: 'root_finesse' for dexterity, 'root_force' for strength.

definition.description_long: Defines the 5 root competencies: Force, Finesse, Awareness, Insight, Influence.
definition.description_short: Defines the 5 root competencies: Force, Finesse, Awareness, Insight, Influence

style_injections.content: If [HUNGER] is 'Hungry' or 'Starving', the NPC must express a desire for food. If 'Starving', physical actions suffer (describe trembling/weakness).

definition.description_long: Decays Satiety when the AI signals that time has passed. Applies narrative tags for hunger states.

definition.name: NPC Relationships

args.reason: NPC pulls away. Intimacy requires higher Romance (>75) or established relationship.

style_injections.content: Check [CRITICAL MEMORY SPOTLIGHT]. If it is not 'None', you MUST color your dialogue with this specific history. Do not explicitly recite the memory; allow it to dictate your emotional tone (e.g., Cold, Grateful).
Review [RELATIONSHIP METRICS]. If 'Romance' > 70, use softer language and lingering glances. If 'Trust' < 30, be guarded and verify information. If 'Resentment' > 50, use passive-aggressive phrasing.

definition.description_long: Manages the relationship graph and mathematically determines the 'Active Context' for the AI based on tag severity.

definition.name: Stamina-Based Magic

logic.description: Magic is heavy. Costs 25 Stamina (1/4 of tank).
Uses the entity's preferred casting stat (defined in state) to control the energy.
Updates physical condition immediately after cast.

casting_stat_id.description: The ID of the stat used to resolve spellcasting.

definition.description_long: Casting spells requires significant physical energy. Overcasting leads to exhaustion or collapse.

definition.name: Vitality & Stamina System

logic.description: Advances the world clock (0-24 scale). Engine handles wrap-around.
Cross-System: Decays satiety if Needs system is present. Ignored if not.

style_injections.content: If [PHYSICAL CONDITION] is 'Exhausted' or 'Collapsed', NPCs must urge the player to stop. Narration should describe heavy limbs and stumbling.

instructions.logic: Check [PHYSICAL CONDITION]. If it is 'Collapsed', REJECT any intent to 'travel', 'fight', or 'explore'. Force the intent to 'struggle_and_fail' or 'rest_action' only.

definition.description_short: Tracks physical energy. Enforces resting mechanics and pacing through exhaustion penalties

style_injections.content: Do not list inventory. Instead, describe the character's appearance based on [VISIBLE GEAR]. If 'Heavy Infantry', mention clanking steel. If 'Rogue', mention concealed blades.

definition.name: World Cycle & Time Bands

style_injections.content: Use [TIME OF DAY] to strictly dictate lighting and NPC activity levels. 'High Noon' is bright/active. 'Deep Night' is dark/quiet/dangerous. 'Pre-Dawn' is foggy/cold.

instructions.logic: If action implies time passing, attach 'duration_tag'. 'moment' (0h), 'scene' (1h), 'short_rest' (1h), 'long_rest' (8h), 'journey' (4h).

style_injections.content: Use [TIME OF DAY] to color the description. 'Deep Night' implies stealth/danger. 'Midday' implies bustle/heat.

instructions.logic: If the user's action implies time passing, you MUST attach a 'duration_tag' parameter. 'moment' (Talking/Fighting), 'scene' (Searching a room), 'short_rest' (Eating/Bandaging), 'long_rest' (Sleeping), 'journey' (Travel).

definition.description_long: The AI determines if an action is a 'Moment', 'Scene', or 'Journey'. The engine advances the clock accordingly.
definition.description_short: AI-driven time tracking. Converts narrative duration into world ticks.

time_band.description: Narrative phase of the day (e.g. High Noon, Deep Night).
